syllabus_topics: Introduction. Culture, ethics, and organizational structure.
assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) in the normal period is the sum of two T30 mini-tests (4.5 points each), valid participation in the IST Management Challenge (2 points), and a 1-hour exam (9 points). For the resit period, a 1.5-hour exam covering all material accounts for 100% of the final grade. The best score from the normal and resit periods counts. For special period students and working students, a single 1.5-hour exam covering all material accounts for 100% of the final grade.
